note: Runs directly as the image's elasticsearch user (uid 101), so the entrypoint skips its chown and gosu steps: gosu (an old Go binary) aborts under Rosetta on Apple Silicon with `runtime: failed to create new OS thread (have 2 already; errno=22)` (real install run 8). The data volume is a bind directory under runtime/volumes/ owned by the host user; the one-shot elasticsearch_data_init chowns it to 101:101 first (PR #33 review r1 R1-01), so Linux/WSL hosts start too.
